summary: Rejection can make you want someone’s approval more than you wanted what you originally asked them for.
body: Rejection can make you want someone’s approval more than you wanted what you originally asked them for. When Venus opposes Saturn, affection, money, recognition, or commitment can meet a limit that feels personal enough to make you start offering more, asking for less, or trying harder to become the person who gets a yes. The boundary may still disappoint you, but disappointment is different from inadequacy. Find out what is actually unavailable before you negotiate away something important just to change somebody else’s answer.
